repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard specifically designed for AI coding agents.
bullets: Built with Python, providing a local-first architecture that ensures data privacy for sensitive development workflows.
Integrates directly with agentic tools like Claude Code and Codex to monitor execution steps, file modifications, and test outcomes.
Provides granular financial transparency by calculating token usage, latency, and monetary costs per individual task.
Enables developers to audit agent performance and optimize spending on LLM-driven software engineering.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: EthanXiang777/circuit-framework
repos.description: Circuit Framework — multi-agent LLM trading research system
repos.one_liner: A specialized multi-agent framework designed for quantitative trading research and strategy development.
bullets: Utilizes a Python-based multi-agent architecture to decouple data processing, strategy generation, and backtesting.
Designed to facilitate complex financial workflows where autonomous agents collaborate on market analysis and signal validation.
Supports modular research pipelines, allowing quants to swap agent roles for different asset classes or trading styles.
Focuses on the intersection of LLM reasoning and systematic trading, bridging the gap between natural language research and quantitative execution.

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance local dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Engineered with a hybrid approach: deterministic mathematical computation for sentiment metrics and LLM integration for narrative synthesis.
Features a local-first execution model that supports private API keys, ensuring zero-latency data processing for time-sensitive market reviews.
Calculates complex financial indicators like 'limit-up' pools, ladder sequences, and capital flow without relying on external AI black boxes.
Provides a visual interface for tracking market 'money-making effects' and sentiment cycles, essential for high-frequency retail trading.
